description: Read-only operation — no side effects, no parameters. Returns this service's flagship trading-agent signals for ETH, ONDO, KAITO and DEGEN: action, confidence, price_usd and the model's reasoning. Use it when you need a directional call rather than raw market data; use get_whale_flow for large-transfer flow and get_arbitrage_opportunities for cross-DEX spreads.
name: get_trading_signal
